verdict.rationale: A local programmatic endpoint for querying codes and secrets is a fair question for an authenticator vault app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only touch-UI interactions (swipe, search, QR export/import) and Google Account sync. The PAM module and the rooted-device sqlite access are adjacent or user-side workarounds, not a product-provided endpoint, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
